description: This file is a Makefile for building the Linux kernel within the OpenWrt build system. It includes rules for preparing, configuring, compiling, and cleaning kernel components, as well as downloading kernel sources and generating symbol tables.

methods.name: Kernel/CompileImage
methods.description: Default kernel image compilation, including initramfs.

methods.name: Kernel/Clean
methods.description: Default cleaning of kernel build artifacts.

methods.name: Download/kernel
methods.description: Defines kernel source URL, file, and hash for download.

methods.name: Download/git-kernel
methods.description: Defines git repository details for kernel source clone.

methods.name: Kernel/CollectDebug
methods.description: Collects kernel debug symbols and creates a compressed debug tarball.
